2. Petitioners as plaintiffs filed the aforesaid suit for partition in the suit land measuring 34.30 acres of land of SA Khatian Nos. 167 and 168 recorded in the name of one Seku Mog on the allegation that the said Seku Mog died leaving wife Suma Mogni and daughter Mayencha Mogni and the said Suma Mogni died leaving daughter Mayencha who died leaving husband Shekbayo Mog, two sons Chinmoykhe and Ulthang Chin and daughter Monche Mogni; that the said persons sold 13.34 acres of land to the plaintiffs by registered kabalas on different dates and after sale of 1048 acres to defts 21, 24 and 28, they claimed partition of their 11.34 acres of land out of 34.30 acres of suit land. 

 4. On the date of peremptory hearing of the suit opposite party Nos. 1-8 filed an application on 18.11.85 for adding them as parties in the suit on the allegation that recorded owner Seku Mog died leaving first born son Seyu Mog who inherited 4 annas share and widow Suma Mogni who inherited 12 annas share; that Suma Mogni died leaving daughter Mayencha Mogni and two sons Sefafru and Alafru; that Sefafru Mog died leaving brother Alafru; that Seyu Mog died leaving son Shacha Awog; That Shacha and Alafru sold by kabalas some lands of the suit khatians to the opposite party Nos. 1-8. Upon consideration of the said application Court below by the impugned order added the opposite party Nos. 1-8 as defendants in the suit.
